source_binding.mechanism: event-sourced compensating rollback plus expected-revision optimistic concurrency

public_sources.claim_used: Event sourcing keeps events append-only/immutable; undo is represented by a compensating event while the original event remains in history.
A stream append can require an exact expected revision; revision mismatch provides optimistic-concurrency rejection for stale writers.
Duplicate appends can be idempotently recognized by event identity when optimistic concurrency is not disabled.

source_binding.literal_external_runtime_reason: No EventStoreDB/Kurrent/Azure hosted service, SDK runner, external model, or cloud allowance is on the accepted route. The public systems supply mechanism semantics only.
source_binding.chat_native_reduction: Represent promotion, contradictions, and rollback as immutable role-local event artifacts. Treat current role-local sequence/blob identity as the expected revision and authority_epoch as a fencing token. Append a compensating rollback event instead of rewriting prior evidence.
